title: Smoked Paprika Chicken Skewers
description: A flavorful and easy-to-make dish perfect for a quick weeknight dinner or a summer barbecue. The smoky flavor of the paprika pairs well with the charred sweetness of the red peppers.
instructions: Thread chicken and red peppers onto skewers.
In a small bowl, mix together smoked paprika, honey, and olive oil.
Brush the mixture evenly onto the chicken and peppers.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Grill the skewers for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally.
Cook until the chicken is cooked through and the peppers are tender.
Remove from heat and let rest for 2-3 minutes.
